propositions: Bridge provider matrix test fails locally on dev hosts where agent harnesses export command-scope git config (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_*, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_*) but passes in CI due to inherited os.environ in git() and bare_git() helpers triggering safe.bareRepository=explicit rejection.

Test harness git subprocesses inherit ambient GIT_CONFIG_* environment variables from the host, causing bare repository operations to fail with 'fatal: cannot use bare repository' when safe.bareRepository is set to explicit.

21 test failures occur across three heldout test files (test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout.py, test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py, test_bridge_runner_install_paths_heldout.py) on hosts with exported command-scope git config injection but zero failures in CI.

Fix requires scrubbing GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_*/VALUE_*/PARAMETERS from os.environ in git() and bare_git() helpers and runner_env(), and pinning GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 to isolate tests from host git config.

Strengthened matrix test must monkeypatch the hostile git config injection (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.bareRepository, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=explicit) deterministically to ensure regression coverage in CI and prevent future dev-host divergence.

gh-independence contract must remain unbroken; test must still fail if gh is added to the fake_bin symlink path, proving the matrix isolation holds against the actual tool rather than environment pollution.
